title: Advisory, Compliance and Assurance Entitlements of the Sentinel Tiers
content:
Sentinel Managed Security tiers carry advisory and assurance entitlements in addition to detection services: phishing simulations, analyst posture reviews, a named lead analyst, compliance evidence reports, a cyber insurance attestation letter and a pass-through ransomware warranty.

## Entitlement definitions

- **Phishing simulations**: phishing simulation campaigns included per contract year.
- **Security posture reviews**: security posture reviews with an analyst per contract year.
- **Named lead analyst**: whether a named lead analyst is assigned.
- **Compliance evidence reports**: the frameworks for which compliance evidence reports are produced, drawn from the compliance framework values a client may declare on its profile (none, HIPAA, PCI DSS, CMMC Level 2, FINRA and SEC).
- **Cyber insurance attestation**: whether an annual controls attestation letter for cyber insurance renewals is provided.
- **Ransomware warranty**: the maximum reimbursement under the EDR vendor's ransomware warranty passed through to the client (USD per incident).

## Entitlements by tier

| Sentinel tier | Phishing simulations per contract year | Posture reviews per contract year | Named lead analyst | Compliance evidence report frameworks | Cyber insurance attestation letter | Ransomware warranty (USD per incident) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 0 | 0 | No | None | No | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 0 | 0 | No | None | Yes | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 4 | 1 | No | HIPAA | Yes | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 12 | 4 | No | HIPAA, PCI DSS, CMMC Level 2 | Yes | 100000 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 12 | 4 | No | HIPAA, PCI DSS, CMMC Level 2, FINRA and SEC | Yes | 250000 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 12 | 12 | Yes | HIPAA, PCI DSS, CMMC Level 2, FINRA and SEC | Yes | 1000000 |

## Framework listing, read by framework

| Declared framework | Tiers whose compliance evidence reports list it | Lowest tier listing it |
|---|---|---|
| HIPAA | Sentinel MDR Advanced, Sentinel MDR Complete, Sentinel XDR Premier, Sentinel XDR Enterprise | Sentinel MDR Advanced |
| PCI DSS | Sentinel MDR Complete, Sentinel XDR Premier, Sentinel XDR Enterprise | Sentinel MDR Complete |
| CMMC Level 2 | Sentinel MDR Complete, Sentinel XDR Premier, Sentinel XDR Enterprise | Sentinel MDR Complete |
| FINRA and SEC | Sentinel XDR Premier, Sentinel XDR Enterprise | Sentinel XDR Premier |

## Notes on the schedule

- Only Sentinel XDR Enterprise assigns a named lead analyst.
- The ransomware warranty figure is a maximum per incident; it is zero on the three lowest tiers and rises to 1000000 USD per incident on Sentinel XDR Enterprise.
- Sentinel EDR Essentials is the only tier without the cyber insurance attestation letter.
